children.value:
dfs   <- c(1, 5, 10, 15, 20, 30, 50, 100, Inf)
levels_c <- c(0.90, 0.95, 0.99)
tbl <- sapply(levels_c, function(C) qt(1 - (1 - C) / 2, dfs))
out <- data.frame(df = ifelse(is.finite(dfs), as.character(dfs), "Inf (= z)"),
                  check.names = FALSE)
out[paste0("t*_", levels_c * 100, "%")] <- fmt(tbl)
out

children.value: Why we still teach the tables
The R functions and the printed tables answer the

two questions
(“how much area?” / “what cutoff?”). Reading a table once makes

stop feeling like magic — you can always sanity-check software against the
reference tables generated on this page.
